 Print Rohit Naidu’s unexpected elimination from Bigg Boss Telugu 10 is still a talking point among viewers. His exit, which came through a decision by the housemates, left many of his fans disappointed. Now, fresh speculation about a possible return has caught their attention. A recent tweet by Bigg Boss Telugu Season 4 winner Abhijeet has added to the curiosity, with fans wondering whether Rohit could get another chance to enter the house. Rohit’s elimination during the Week 8 weekend episodes came as a surprise, as the decision was based on the housemates’ votes rather than the usual audience voting. His supporters didn’t take it well, and many questioned the decision on social media. Hashtags such as #JusticeForRohit gained traction, with viewers demanding that he be given another opportunity in the game. Fuelling the re-entry speculation, Abhijeet recently shared a post that read, “The Sun Will Shine Again”. He didn’t mention Rohit directly, but the timing of the tweet got Bigg Boss viewers talking. Fans believe the post could be linked to Rohit, especially since Abhijeet had guided him before he entered the show and had also played a role in selecting him during the Agnipariksha process. All of this has sparked discussions about whether the tweet hints at a comeback. Watch From Riya Ahir, Mahhi Vij to Qazi Touqeer, here’s the contestant lineup for Bigg Boss 20 For now, there has been no official confirmation from the Bigg Boss makers about Rohit’s re-entry. Since his elimination, he has reportedly been spending time with his family and friends. Some viewers are hopeful of seeing him back in the house, while others feel his chances of returning remain uncertain. Fans are also pointing to earlier instances of contestants Charan and Shalini getting another opportunity in the game. They hope Rohit will get a similar chance and that the makers will take into account the support he has been receiving outside the house. Whether the speculation turns into reality, though, remains to be seen. Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more. Download the TOI app.
